text:
Clara (PM): Quick thread 1-week sprint to validate DP intake + prioritization matrix. Proposal: 6 partners, two tracks (performance, product). Main questions: recruitment filter, launch gates, and incentive structure.
Derek (Eng): +1. For perf track we must define p95 targets and a clear fallback. Suggest shipping a perf probe and a per-partner feature-flag.
Noah (ProdOps): Ops checklist: access window, pre-onboard smoke, signed access form. Capacity ask: reserve 1 x A100 equiv per partner for week1. If >75% GPU util, auto-throttle new onboardings.
Ema (Design): Intake should be a 3-field pulse: use-case summary, 1 primary success metric, expected tokens/day. That keeps screening quick for Sales. I'll create a one-pager. :memo:
Pri (CS): Incentives: $400 credit or co-marketing + case study option. Support cadence: weekly 15m check-ins first 2 weeks, then biweekly. SLA during onboarding: respond <3 hours for sev1.
Clara (PM): Launch gates idea: (A) 4/6 partners onboarded within 10 business days, (B) no >1 P1 stability incident across partners, (C) quality regression <4% vs baseline on our eval set. Agree?
Derek (Eng): Add instrumentation gate: per-partner telemetry (latency p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, error-rate) must be streaming to Console. Also need a synthetic prompt suite for regression checks.
Noah (ProdOps): Legal/DP: require DP checklist for Private deployments. LegalBot 1 can you confirm required clauses?
LegalBot: Reminder: include data processing addendum + access window clause + encryption at rest note. Route draft to legal-review.
Ema (Design): Feedback loop UX: weekly 3-question survey + in-app "report regression" button + mid-cohort retro. I'll mock the survey and reporter widget.
Pri (CS): Recruitment filter to give Sales: 1) prod-ish usage or >5M tokens/day, 2) need VPC/on-prem access, 3) committed feedback cadence. I'll compile a short outreach blurb.
Clara (PM): Action items: Ema = intake + survey mock, Derek = telemetry + fallback snippet, Noah = infra reserve + access form, Pri = incentive copy + recruit blurb, LegalBot = start DPA draft. Reconvene Wed 10am. Any objections?
Derek (Eng): No objections. I'll post a `route->fallback` snippet before EOD Tue.
Noah (ProdOps): I'll share the access form and schedule the pre-onboard smoke slot.
Ema (Design): Will post the one-pager and survey in #product and link the mock.
Pri (CS): I'll add candidate names to the sheet and ping sales.
Clara (PM): Great 1 thanks all. One more: capture two sample partner profiles (edge-case: tiny usage but strict regs; large usage with low ops support) so Sales can triage. I'll draft in the sheet.
